reasoning: The outstretched human figure is the standard UI glyph for accessibility, combined with a magnifying glass indicating inspection, auditing, or screen magnification. It fits web/app accessibility audits, low-vision zoom settings, and secondarily full-body medical inspections or people searches. It can be confused with general user-search icons or stretching figures.
